title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 3: First cDNA Strand Synthesis
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to 4 °C (can be done manually before starting the protocol).

steps.title: Add strand specificity reagent
steps.instruction: Dispense 8 µL of strand specificity reagent from the temperature module located in slot 3, column 1 into each sample.

steps.title: Add enzyme mix and mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 2 µL of enzyme mix from the temperature module located in slot 3, column 3 into each sample, then mix to combine.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL enzyme mix to each sample.
Mix the reaction to combine the added enzyme mix.

steps.title: Alert user of completion
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 robot will flash to notify the user that the protocol is complete.
